query:
INSERT INTO attachments
                (id, message_id, file_id, created_at)
            VALUES
                (?, ?, ?, ?)
            RETURNING
                id as "id!: Uuid",
                message_id as "message_id!: Uuid",
                file_id as "file_id!: Uuid",
                created_at as "created_at!: time::OffsetDateTime"
            ;
